AIADMK Leaders Join TVK Amidst Party Exodus

Several former ministers, MLAs, and cadres from the AIADMK party have joined the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK). This move signifies a continuation of an ongoing exodus from the AIADMK. Some reports also highlight concerns about the anti-corruption stance of TVK with these new entrants.
